html:
G'oya

Oylik hisobot: bekor qilinganlarni WHERE da olib tashlab, oy bo'yicha guruhlaymiz. Bu masalada ikki narsani ajratish kerak. Guruh kaliti va saralash kaliti vaqt bo'lishi kerak, chiqadigan 'MM.YYYY' esa faqat ko'rinish. '01.2024' matn sifatida '12.2023' dan kichik, shuning uchun natijani shu ustun bo'yicha saralab bo'lmaydi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', starts_at), 'MM.YYYY') AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS visits,
       SUM(price) AS revenue
FROM visits
WHERE status = 'done'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', starts_at)
ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', starts_at)

DATE_TRUNC('month', ...) vaqtni oyning birinchi kuni 00:00 ga tushiradi. Guruhlash va saralash shu vaqt bo'yicha, TO_CHAR esa faqat chiqishda ishlaydi.

Faqat SQLiteSELECT strftime('%m.%Y', starts_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS visits,
       SUM(price) AS revenue
FROM visits
WHERE status = 'done'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', starts_at)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', starts_at)

SQLite'da yil oldin turgan '%Y-%m' kalit to'g'ri saralanadi, chiqishga esa '%m.%Y' yoziladi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BY month namunada 01.2024, 03.2024, 12.2023 beradi. Matn chapdan solishtiriladi va oy raqami yildan oldin turibdi:

Noto'g'riSELECT strftime('%m.%Y', starts_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(price) AS revenue
FROM visits
WHERE status = 'done'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', starts_at)
ORDER BY month

Andozada oy va daqiqani adashtirmang: PostgreSQL'da oy MM, daqiqa MI; SQLite'da oy %m, daqiqa %M. Xato chiqmaydi, guruhlar shunchaki daqiqalar bo'yicha bo'linib ketadi.

Bekor qilinganlarni CASE bilan nolga aylantirsangiz, faqat bekor qilingan fevral 0 bilan natijaga kirib qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Vaqtni matnga aylantirib, bo'laklarini SUBSTR bilan qayta terish ikkala bazada ishlaydi. Saralash uchun guruhdagi eng erta vaqt yetarli:

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(starts_at AS TEXT), 6, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(CAST(starts_at AS TEXT), 1, 4) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS visits,
       SUM(price) AS revenue
FROM visits
WHERE status = 'done'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(starts_at AS TEXT), 6, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(CAST(starts_at AS TEXT), 1, 4)
ORDER BY MIN(starts_at)
